title: Migraine Recovery Duration by Trigger
dataSources: Allergy symptoms (`allergy:entry`), migraine records (`migraine:entry`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), and sleep-talking events (`sleeptalk:event`).
app: Symptom telemetry for allergy diaries, migraine aura tracking, bathroom frequency logging, and sleep-talking review sent to Splunk HEC via apps and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=migraine:entry
| search recovery_hr=*
| stats avg(recovery_hr) as avg_recovery_hr perc90(recovery_hr) as p90_recovery_hr count as samples by trigger_type
| sort 0 - avg_recovery_hr
description: Measures migraine recovery duration by trigger type.
value: Recovery duration by trigger helps you plan around the attacks that cost the most time after the pain itself ends.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for migraine recovery duration to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 migraine recovery duration.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how long migraine recovery duration usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
